summary: Comprehensive testing of multi-cohort frontend/backend integration. All 9 backend cohort tests passed (cohort filtering for stats, submissions, post-eval-stats, CSV exports, post-eval CSV exports, admin login, cohorts endpoint). Frontend E2E flows verified: cohort selector toggles correctly between Cohort 1 (Lagos) and Cohort 2 (Abuja); Cohort 1 shows training-complete badge + gallery + post-eval button; Cohort 2 shows upcoming badge + countdown + start-assessment button; clicking post-eval CTA stores leadway_cohort=cohort_1_lagos in localStorage and navigates to /post-evaluation; clicking Start Pre-Training Assessment + email submit stores cohort_2_abuja + email and navigates to /assessment; admin login (leadway2026) works; admin dashboard cohort filter dropdown shows all 3 options (All Cohorts, Cohort 1 — Lagos, Cohort 2 — Abuja); selecting a cohort refreshes stats correctly.

issues: Recharts console warnings about width(-1)/height(-1) - cosmetic, charts still render. Known issue from previous iterations.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is large (~1700+ lines) - consider splitting into modules (routes/, models/, services/) per code review guideline (>700 line files).
AdminDashboard.jsx is also very large (~1200+ lines) - extracting PostEvalTabContent into its own file would help.

Submission default cohort is 'cohort_2_abuja' but PostEvalDraftCreate/PostEvalSubmissionCreate default is 'cohort_1_lagos' - inconsistent defaults. Frontend always supplies cohort so not a runtime issue, but worth aligning.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_ prefixed submissions (TEST_cohort_cohort_1_lagos@leadway.com, TEST_cohort_cohort_2_abuja@leadway.com) and 2 TEST_ post-evaluations (TEST_pe_cohort_1_lagos, TEST_pe_cohort_2_abuja). Used for backend verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-cohort integration is fully working end-to-end. Cohort filter on admin dashboard correctly drives stats/submissions/report/post-eval-stats refresh via fetchData() dependency on cohortFilter. Backend supports cohort=cohort_1_lagos or cohort_2_abuja on /api/admin/stats, /api/admin/post-eval-stats, /api/submissions, /api/admin/export, /api/admin/post-eval-export, /api/admin/report (and /api/admin/report/pdf, /api/admin/post-eval-report/pdf). LocalStorage keys: leadway_cohort, leadway_email. SessionStorage key for admin: leadway_admin.
